pending.reason: Reporting obligation (name the net and execution model; do not report equal API checks as net equivalence); no test checks report contents. Related: the evidence envelope of quaat/weave#7 is to record the profile and source hashes.
Deployment requirement; the repository has no deployment or adapter that claims capability enforcement, and no test. Related: the adapter ABI of milestone M2 (quaat/weave#56).

The listed R0 tests cover scripted receipt correlation only. Authentication and account scoping of provider evidence are not implemented (security chapter). Related: the adapter ABI of milestone M2 (quaat/weave#56).

Reports MUST identify trusted components' versions and assumptions. The listed test checks that the N0 proof text names some unestablished assumptions; no test checks versions. The evidence envelope of quaat/weave#7 is to record assumptions and tool versions.

SEC-REPLAY-1.note: R0 process-crash model only; there is no adapter contract with provider retention horizons.
